description: Standard CRUD view scaffold (Pattern B: separated List + Dialog) using ZxGridList + ZxDialog

variables.entity: entity name in lowerCamelCase or kebab-case (example: config)

files.components/index.ts:
export { default as {{Entity}}List } from './{{Entity}}List.vue';
export { default as {{Entity}}Dialog } from './{{Entity}}Dialog.vue';
files.components/{{Entity}}Dialog.vue:
<template>
  <ZxDialog v-bind="dialogProps" v-on="dialogEvents">
    <el-form ref="formRef" :model="state.data" :rules="formRules" label-width="88px">
      <el-form-item label="名称" prop="name">
        <el-input v-model="state.data.name" placeholder="请输入名称" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="状态" prop="status">
        <el-radio-group v-model="state.data.status">
          <el-radio value="0">启用</el-radio>
          <el-radio value="1">停用</el-radio>
        </el-radio-group>
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="备注" prop="remark">
        <el-input v-model="state.data.remark" type="textarea" :rows="3" placeholder="请输入备注" />
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>
  </ZxDialog>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" name="{{Entity}}Dialog">
import { add{{Entity}}, update{{Entity}} } from '@/api/{{module}}/{{entity}}';
import { useDialog } from '@zxio/zxui';
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus';

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'success'): void;
}>();

const formRef = ref();

const formRules = {
  name: [{ required: true, message: '名称不能为空', trigger: 'blur' }],
};

const { state, dialogProps, dialogEvents, open } = useDialog({
  title: (data: any) => (data?.id ? '修改' : '新增'),
  width: '620px',
  formRef,
  preValidate: true,
  autoScrollToError: true,
  autoResetForm: true,
  defaultData: () => ({
    id: undefined,
    name: '',
    status: '0',
    remark: '',
  }),
  onConfirm: async (data: any) => {
    if (data.id !== undefined && data.id !== null) {
      await update{{Entity}}(data);
      ElMessage.success('修改成功');
    } else {
      await add{{Entity}}(data);
      ElMessage.success('新增成功');
    }
    emit('success');
    return true;
  },
  onConfirmError: (err: any) => {
    ElMessage.error(err?.message || '提交失败，请重试');
  },
});

defineExpose({ open });
</script>
